subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT status, UBL invoice mapping, and PO split guidance
messages:
From: Marcos Diaz <m.diaz@varela-logistics.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding: VAT status & electronic invoice (UBL) for Redwood PO request

Hi Neha,

Thanks for starting the vendor onboarding — attached are our VAT certificate and a recent UBL (XML) sample invoice so your team can validate fields. A few context points:

- Varela Logistics is registered for VAT in Spain (ESX-12345678). We supply freight services from outside the EU into warehouses in NL and DE.
- For services and cross-border freight, our invoicing team typically leaves VAT at 0% and includes the EU reverse-charge note when the customer is VAT-registered in the destination member state.
- We can also issue invoices with VAT if Redwood prefers us to register local VAT in the importing country, but that would require us to update billing and pricing.

Attached: vat_certificate.pdf (PDF), sample_invoice.ubl.xml (UBL v2.1 with VAT tags).

Can you confirm which Redwood legal entity / VAT posting we should map invoices to, and whether you require split POs when goods cross country boundaries? We want to ensure automated mapping of the XML elements into your AP system.

Thanks,
Marcos Diaz
Head of Finance Operations
Varela Logistics
Procurement contact: accounts@varela-logistics.co

--
Attachment stubs: vat_certificate.pdf (PDF), sample_invoice.ubl.xml (XML)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcos Diaz <m.diaz@varela-logistics.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: VAT status & electronic invoice (UBL) for Redwood PO request

Hi Marcos — appreciate the files, they look helpful. Looping in Ben (procurement) and Laura (finance) to confirm Redwood's mapping and PO requirements.

High-level asks for our team to confirm:
- Which Redwood legal entity should we map when creating the supplier record and routing invoices (Redwood Inc. vs Redwood EU Ops)?
- For cross-border shipments, do you want a single consolidated invoice or separate invoice per destination country (we prefer XML that includes country-specific tax nodes)?
- Are there any element IDs in your UBL that differ from the sample you sent? If so, tell us the exact XML path for VATRate/TaxCategory.

I attach the standard Redwood PO template for reference — it has the PO-split flag we use when tax treatment differs by destination.

Next steps: Ben/Laura — can you advise on 1) reverse-charge vs vendor VAT registration, 2) whether finance will require a fiscal representative for Spain/NL, and 3) evidence needed before we flip the supplier to active?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Onboarding, Procurement
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: redwood_sample_po_template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcos Diaz <m.diaz@varela-logistics.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: VAT status & electronic invoice (UBL) for Redwood PO request

Thanks, Neha. Quick procurement note and operational checklist for Marcos so we can progress the vendor setup without blocking payment.

Procurement decision points (short):
- Legal entity: Map to Redwood EU Ops (Redwood B.V.) for all freight/service invoices that are billed to EU shipping endpoints. That keeps AP routing and tax reclaim aligned.
- PO splitting: If the invoice XML includes multiple line-level tax jurisdictions (e.g., DE + NL), we prefer separate POs per destination country to make VAT reporting and inventory cost allocation straightforward. Use the PO-split flag in the attached template.
- Reverse charge: For services where Varela is not charging VAT and provides a Spanish VAT number, we apply reverse charge and do not collect VAT from the vendor. Vendor must include reverse-charge phrasing on the invoice.

Required onboarding items from Varela to activate supplier in our system:
1) VAT certificate (official government or EU VIES printout) — received.
2) A sample UBL XML mapped to your internal schema — received.
3) Signed vendor setup form (DocuSign link below).
4) If you plan to bill with local VAT in any EU country, confirm which entity will register and provide local VAT registration docs.

DocuSign (vendor setup): https://www.docusign.com/link/REDWOOD-VL-VENDOR-SETUP-2026
HubSpot vendor record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/987654321

Marcos — if you can return the signed vendor_setup_form.docx via DocuSign and confirm whether you'll issue single or split invoices, we can proceed to create the supplier record and assign PO number ranges.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs referenced: vendor_setup_form.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcos Diaz <m.diaz@varela-logistics.co>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: VAT status & electronic invoice (UBL) for Redwood PO request

Hi all — following up with finance mapping requirements and the minimal evidence we need before marking the vendor as active in Redwood EU Ops. Summarized below; please read each item and confirm delivery timeline so we don't delay the first PO.

Finance mapping & validation (for XML -> AP ingest):
- Required XML elements we will ingest from your UBL: Invoice/AccountingSupplierParty/Party/PartyIdentification (supplier VAT ID), TaxTotal/TaxSubtotal/TaxCategory/ID, TaxTotal/TaxSubtotal/TaxAmount, LegalMonetaryTotal/PayableAmount, TaxTotal/TaxAmount/@currencyID. Please ensure TaxCategory includes VATPercent element.
- If you produce line-level tax country codes, include the SellerTaxRegistration/ID element with country prefix (e.g., ESX-12345678).
- For reverse charge invoices, include the clause: "Reverse charge — Article 196 (EU)" in Invoice/Note so our parser tags it correctly.
- File naming: please send UBL files named with our vendor ID once created (e.g., VL-98765-invoice-20261130.xml).

Evidence needed before activation:
1) VAT certificate (government or VIES print) — received and validated against ES registry.
2) Signed vendor setup form (DocuSign) — pending.
3) Confirmation of invoicing approach: a single consolidated invoice or split by destination country. If split, provide mapping table of line items to country codes.

Operational notes on withholding / tax liability:
- If you bill services with a valid EU VAT ID and include the reverse-charge clause, Redwood will account for VAT under reverse charge and will not pay VAT to you. That is standard for B2B services.
- If you elect to charge local VAT (because you register in NL/DE), finance will treat those invoices as standard VATable purchases and we will reclaim VAT where allowed. Please provide local registration docs for the specific country.

Next steps and timeline:
- Marcos: please sign the DocuSign vendor form and confirm whether you will issue split invoices.
- Once DocuSign is returned, procurement (Ben) will request PO ranges and finance (me) will provision XML ingest mapping and do a final test with your sample UBL.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0102
